_doc.what: Canonical knob surface for YURI's ICM/MWP energy gate, Layer-C salience/surprise encoder, the procedural-memory forgetting horizon, AND the subconscious memory loop (fsrs demote + recall blend + conscious-set cap). Read by loadEnergyConfig() in _SYSTEM/Scripts/math/yuri-energy-config.mjs; the weights/threshold/salience are merged over the hardcoded defaults in energy-tick-core.mjs (tickAndTrace), evict.ttlDays is read by memory-evict.mjs, fsrs:{} feeds memory-relocator/yuri-fsrs, recall:{} feeds yuri-recall, and recall.consciousSetCap is read by brain-inject.js. Editing a value here steers the live system; this is what the future tuning cockpit persists to.
_doc.failsafe: The loader is fail-closed: unknown keys are dropped, non-finite/negative weights are rejected, and an absent or malformed file falls back entirely to the in-code defaults. A typo here can never corrupt the gate or the evictor.
_doc.values_are_defaults: Every value below equals the current in-code default (DEFAULT_WEIGHTS in yuri-energy.mjs, DEFAULT_SALIENCE in energy-tick-core.mjs, threshold 0, evict TTL 90). Creating/editing this file with these values therefore changes NO behavior — it only externalizes the knobs so they can be tuned without a code edit.
_doc.evict_precedence: memory-evict.mjs resolves its TTL as: env MEMORY_EVICT_TTL_DAYS (ops override, must be a finite number >= 1, truncated to whole days) > this file's evict.ttlDays > 90-day default.

ranges.weights.*: finite, >= 0 (fail-closed: violations dropped, gate uses default for that key)
ranges.threshold: finite (any sign); deltaU <= threshold accepts a transition; default 0
ranges.salience.depthThreshold: integer >= 1; meaningful transitions before the surprise tier can engage
ranges.salience.surpriseK: >= 0; |deltaU| must exceed median + K*MAD of the recent band to count as surprise (lower -> encode more, higher -> only shocks)
ranges.salience.surpriseWindow: integer >= 3; how many recent |deltaU| samples define the band (below 3, isSurprise can never form a band and the surprise tier silently disables — the loader enforces the >= 3 floor)
ranges.evict.ttlDays: integer >= 1; procedural-memory pattern files whose atime age exceeds this are archived (memory-evict.mjs)
ranges.fsrs.rFloor: finite, 0 < x <= 1; retrievability floor below which a memory demotes to the subconscious cold store (memory-relocator via yuri-fsrs evaluateRetention). Lower = forget less.
ranges.fsrs.decay: finite, < 0; FSRS power-law decay exponent (default -0.5 → R(t=S)=0.9).
ranges.fsrs.salience / fsrs.freq / fsrs.deltaU: finite, >= 0; weights that lift effective STABILITY (slower decay) from salience, recall frequency, and encode-surprise.
ranges.fsrs.redundancyFloor: finite, 0 <= x <= 1; MEM-02 MDL axis — normalized gzip marginal-bits below which a body is REDUNDANT (predicted by the rest of the kept store). Demote requires R<rFloor AND marginalBits<redundancyFloor. 0 disables the axis (pure-FSRS baseline). Higher = treat more bodies as redundant.
ranges.fsrs.supersessionPenaltyDays: finite, >= 0; MEM-05 — days by which OLDER same-family anchors (e.g. session-resume-*) are back-dated so they cross rFloor once a NEWER sibling exists; the newest stays warm. 0 disables the supersession pass.
ranges.fsrs.renewalScale: finite, > 0; MEM-06 card 29-H1 renewal-RATE scale — effectiveStability boosts by freq·log1p(r·scale), r=useCount/max(elapsedDays,minWindow). Frequency-per-time, not raw count.
ranges.fsrs.renewalMinWindowDays: finite, >= 1; MEM-06 minimum elapsed-days window for the renewal rate (a 1-day burst can't inflate the rate); also the recall-count floor below which an item falls back to the count-based prior.
ranges.recall.relevanceFloor: finite, >= 0; min BM25 relevance for a cold hit to surface (yuri-recall rankRecall).
ranges.recall.topK: integer >= 1; max cold traces surfaced per cue.
ranges.recall.halfLifeDays: finite, >= 1; recency half-life in the recall blend.
ranges.recall.consciousSetCap: integer >= 1; max curated MEMORY.md rows kept in the conscious set (brain-inject loadCuratedMemory). On overflow, the most retrievable rows win.
ranges.recall.weights.*: finite, >= 0; bm25/recency/salience/crosslink blend weights for cue recall.

weight_meanings.beta: klDivergence(claimed, verified) — drift between claim and evidence (strong penalty)
weight_meanings.zeta: sum(staleness) — stale evidence dragging state up
weight_meanings.iota: -verifiedEvidenceCount — verified evidence subtracts from U (logarithmic, saturating)
weight_meanings.kappa: repeatedFailurePenalty — per-event count of confidently-wrong predictions
weight_meanings.lambda: malformedForecastPenalty — out-of-range/non-finite forecast inputs fail CLOSED
